finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.sink: board[choice - 1] = player.symbol; // Sets cell as taken
finding.assumptions: The player.symbol is not properly sanitized before being used to set the board cell.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked that the sink is an assignment to a string array element (board[choice-1] = player.symbol; and board[choice] = player.symbol;). No system, exec, or similar function is called with player.symbol as an argument. The board array is only used for display via outputBoard, which prints the strings. Therefore player.symbol is not used in any OS command context, eliminating OS command injection risk.
